description: This file defines an API client for managing notes, including functions to list, get, create, update, and delete notes via HTTP requests to a REST API.

methods.name: normalizeBase
methods.description: Trims whitespace and trailing slashes from a base URL string.

methods.name: resolveApiBase
methods.description: Resolves the API base URL from environment variables, with normalization and error handling.

methods.name: apiUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full API URL from a given path and the resolved base URL.

methods.name: requestJson
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request expecting a JSON response, with timeout and error handling.
